items.title: It’s the strangest job market the U.S. has ever seen. The low-hire, low-fire economy turns 3 years old.
items.content: America has always been a job-creating machine. It has broken down for three straight years, and the implications could be with us for a long time.

items.title: AMD’s stock slides after Intel earnings reveal two big issues
items.content: Intel is struggling to make enough AI server chips and dealing with a weak PC market. Investors will soon find out the degree to which AMD may be suffering from the same problems.

items.title: This one chart tells you everything you need to know about Exxon, Chevron and BP’s forecast-beating earnings
items.content: One slide in ExxonMobil’s investor presentation after its third-quarter earnings explains the financial situation for the integrated oil giants very neatly.

items.title: ‘He was heartbroken’: My husband’s kids abandoned him when he was dying. Was he right to leave everything to me?
items.content: “In the end, he left them a few sentimental mementos, some collectibles and old photographs.”

items.title: This Halloween, are king-sized candy bars a better deal than fun-sized ones?
items.content: Several TikTokers influencers claim you can save money and be the coolest house on the block with bigger candy this year. Let’s see how that adds up.

items.title: Why Intel’s stock is sinking toward its worst day in decades — and a $140 billion wipeout
items.content: Intel’s PC business is under pressure as memory-chip prices dent demand and as corporate IT teams have less budget for laptops.

items.title: The cost of money itself is on the ballot as voters struggle with pricey car loans, mortgages and credit-card debt
items.content: Nearly nine in 10 voters — 88% — say they worry the national debt is adding to their own borrowing costs.

items.title: Gen Z voters told us the midterms boil down to affording life, as social causes take a back seat
items.content: MarketWatch talked to younger voters who said many life goals feel unattainable for their generation.

items.title: This credit card is the ‘best weapon’ to fight debt while interest rates keep climbing
items.content: After September’s rate hike and another projected increase in December, borrowing costs are expected to keep climbing for Americans carrying a credit-card balance.

items.title: My father has Alzheimer’s and his caregiver is using his debit card for DoorDash. Is this suspicious?
items.content: “I suspect the live-in caregiver is benefiting from my parent’s generosity.”
